sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, la.AttributeCode AS linkType, CONCAT(p.SKU, la.AttributeCode) AS linkScope, l.cnt AS linkedCount, l.lname1 AS linked1Name, l.lsku1 AS linked1Sku, l.lid1 AS linked1ProductId, l.rp1 AS linked1RetailPrice, l.sp1 AS linked1SalesPrice, l.lcat1 AS linked1Category, l.lq1 AS linked1Quantity, l.lname2 AS linked2Name, l.lsku2 AS linked2Sku, l.lid2 AS linked2ProductId, l.rp2 AS linked2RetailPrice, l.sp2 AS linked2SalesPrice, l.lcat2 AS linked2Category, l.lq2 AS linked2Quantity, l.lname3 AS linked3Name, l.lsku3 AS linked3Sku, l.lid3 AS linked3ProductId, l.rp3 AS linked3RetailPrice, l.sp3 AS linked3SalesPrice, l.lcat3 AS linked3Category, l.lq3 AS linked3Quantity FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute la ON la.AttributeCode = @linkType INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale loc ON loc.IsDefault = @defaultLocale LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile anon ON anon.PortalId = po.PortalId AND anon.IsDefaultAnonymousProfile = @anonymousProfile CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(y.lid) AS cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.lname END) AS lname1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.lsku END) AS lsku1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.lid END) AS lid1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.rp END) AS rp1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.sp END) AS sp1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.lcat END) AS lcat1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n1 THEN y.lq END) AS lq1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.lname END) AS lname2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.lsku END) AS lsku2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.lid END) AS lid2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.rp END) AS rp2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.sp END) AS sp2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.lcat END) AS lcat2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n2 THEN y.lq END) AS lq2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.lname END) AS lname3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.lsku END) AS lsku3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.lid END) AS lid3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.rp END) AS rp3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.sp END) AS sp3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.lcat END) AS lcat3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.n = @n3 THEN y.lq END) AS lq3 FROM (SELECT lp.PimProductId AS lid, lp.SKU AS lsku, lp.ProductName AS lname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS n, gp.RetailPrice AS rp, gp.SalesPrice AS sp, lc.v AS lcat, st.q AS lq FROM dbo.ZnodePimLinkProductDetail lk INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct lp ON lp.PimProductId = lk.PimProductId OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pr.RetailPrice, pr.SalesPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList pl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice pr ON pr.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf ON plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plf.PortalProfileId = anon.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE pr.SKU = lp.SKU AND (plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR plo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY CASE WHEN plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, plf.Precedence, plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pr.PriceId) gp OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ke.CategoryName AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ke INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity kv ON kv.VersionId = ke.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog kc ON kc.PublishCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE ke.ZnodeProductId = lp.PimProductId AND kc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND kv.RevisionType = @publishState AND kv.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND ke.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId ORDER BY ke.VersionId DESC, ke.ProductIndex, ke.PublishProductEntityId) lc OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) AS q FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = lp.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId) st WHERE lk.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND lk.PimAttributeId = la.PimAttributeId AND lp.IsActive = @isActive) y) l WHERE p.PimProductId = @product AND la.AttributeTypeId = (SELECT lt.AttributeTypeId FROM dbo.ZnodeAttributeType lt WHERE lt.AttributeTypeName = @linkAttributeType) AND l.cnt > @zero AND (@minLinked IS NULL OR l.cnt >= @minLinked) ORDER BY p.SKU, la.PimAttributeId
